title: Unlocking LLM Repair Capabilities Through Cross-Language Translation and Multi-Agent Refinement
summary: The original LANTERN pipeline performs direct repair, selects target languages with LLM-based reasoning, translates buggy code across languages, repairs in the target language, back-translates successful fixes, and iteratively refines using historical feedback.
This reproduction replaces that multi-agent cross-language translation and refinement workflow with a simplified single-LLM repair prompt over sampled xCodeEval instances.
